summary: 文明崩溃可能牵涉环境损害、气候变化、敌对邻居和贸易伙伴，最终还取决于社会怎样应对这些压力。
logic: 人类活动造成环境损害
气候变化如何放大已有压力
敌对邻邦的入侵与社会内部弱点
友好邻邦的贸易支持减少
社会如何应对，以及这一框架的适用范围

paragraphs.brief: 人类活动与环境脆弱性
sentences: A first set of factors involves damage that people inadvertently inflict on their environment, as already discussed.
第一组因素涉及人们无意中对环境造成的损害，如前所述。

The extent and reversibility of that damage depend partly on properties of people (e.g., how many trees they cut down per acre per year), and partly on properties of the environment (e.g., properties determining how many seedlings germinate per acre, and how rapidly saplings grow, per year).
破坏程度以及能否恢复，一部分取决于人的做法，如每英亩每年砍多少棵树；另一部分取决于环境自身，如每英亩每年有多少树苗发芽、幼树长得多快。

Those environmental properties are referred to either as fragility (susceptibility to damage) or as resilience (potential for recovery from damage), and one can talk separately of the fragility or resilience of an area’s forests, its soils, its fish populations, and so on.
这些环境特性被称为脆弱性(对损害的可感性)或复原力(对损害复原的潜力)，人们可以分别谈论一个地区的森林、土壤、鱼类种群等的脆弱性或复原力。

Hence the reasons why only certain societies suffered environmental collapses might in principle involve either exceptional imprudence of their people, exceptional fragility of some aspects of their environment, or both.
因此，只有某些社会遭受环境崩溃的原因原则上可能涉及其人民异常的鲁莽、其环境的某些方面异常脆弱，或者两者兼有。
paragraphs.gist: 人类活动造成的环境损害取决于取用资源的强度，也取决于当地森林、土壤或鱼群的脆弱性与恢复力，两者共同影响社会能否承受损失。

paragraphs.brief: 自然力量改变气候的实例
sentences: A next consideration in my five-point framework is climate change, a term that today we tend to associate with global warming caused by humans.
在我的五点框架中，下一个考虑是气候变化，我们今天倾向于把气候变化与人类造成的全球变暖联系起来。

In fact, climate may become hotter or colder, wetter or drier, or more or less variable between months or between years, because of changes in natural forces that drive climate and that have nothing to do with humans.
事实上，与人类无关的自然驱动力发生变化，也能使气候变热或变冷、变湿或变干，甚至改变不同月份或年份之间的波动程度。

Examples of such forces include changes in the heat put out by the sun, volcanic eruptions that inject dust into the atmosphere, changes in the orientation of the Earth’s axis with respect to its orbit, and changes in the distribution of land and ocean over the face of the Earth.
这些自然力量包括太阳放热量变化、火山喷发向大气输送尘埃、地轴相对公转轨道的朝向改变，以及地表海陆分布变化。

Frequently discussed cases of natural climate change include the advance and retreat of continental ice sheets during the Ice Ages beginning over two million years ago, the so-called Little Ice Age from about A.D. 1400 to 1800, and the global cooling following the enormous volcanic eruption of Indonesia’s Mt. Tambora on April 5, 1815.
经常讨论的自然气候变化案例包括两百万年前开始的冰河时代大陆冰盖的推进和退缩，所谓的小冰河时代从公元1400年到1800年左右，以及1815年4月5日印度尼西亚坦博拉山火山爆发后的全球冷却。

That eruption injected so much dust into the upper atmosphere that the amount of sunlight reaching the ground decreased until the dust settled out, causing widespread famines even in North America and Europe due to cold temperatures and reduced crop yields in the summer of 1816 (“the year without a summer”).
火山喷发向上层大气注入了这么多尘埃，到达地面的阳光量在尘埃落定之前有所减少，造成大饥荒，即使在北美和欧洲，由于寒冷的气温和1816年夏季作物产量下降(“没有夏季的一年”)。
paragraphs.gist: 气候会因太阳、地轴或火山等自然因素而变动，坦博拉火山喷出的尘埃遮弱阳光，便曾引起次年降温、歉收和饥荒。

paragraphs.brief: 跨代气候变化与灾荒风险
sentences: Climate change was even more of a problem for past societies with short human lifespans and without writing than it is today, because climate in many parts of the world tends to vary not just from year to year but also on a multi-decade time scale; e.g., several wet decades followed by a dry half-century.
气候变化对过去人类寿命短、没有文字的社会来说，比今天更是一个问题，因为世界许多地区的气候往往不仅每年变化，而且会发生多十年的时间变化，例如，几十年湿后半个世纪干旱。
In many prehistoric societies the mean human generation time—average number of years between births of parents and of their children—was only a few decades.
在许多史前社会，人的平均一代时间——父母生育与子女生育之间的平均年数——只是几十年。
Hence towards the end of a string of wet decades, most people alive could have had no firsthand memory of the previous period of dry climate.
因此，在接连数十年湿润气候快要结束时，仍在世的人大多没有亲身经历过上一个干旱期。
Even today, there is a human tendency to increase production and population during good decades, forgetting (or, in the past, never realizing) that such decades were unlikely to last.
即使在今天，人类也倾向于在数十年好年景中扩大生产和人口，忘了或像过去的人那样从未意识到，好年景不可能一直持续。
When the good decades then do end, the society finds itself with more population than can be supported, or with ingrained habits unsuitable to the new climate conditions.
当好几十年确实结束时，社会的人口就超过可以支持的人口，或具有不适于新气候条件的根深蒂固的习惯。
(Just think today of the dry U.S. West and its urban or rural policies of profligate water use, often drawn up in wet decades on the tacit assumption that they were typical.)
例如，今天美国西部干旱地区的一些城乡用水政策颇为浪费，它们常制定于降水丰沛的几十年间，默认那就是常态。

Compounding these problems of climate change, many past societies didn’t have “disaster relief” mechanisms to import food surpluses from other areas with a different climate into areas developing food shortages.
许多古代社会缺乏“灾害救济”机制，无法在某地开始缺粮时从气候不同的地区调入余粮，这使气候变化带来的困难雪上加霜。
All of those considerations exposed past societies to increased risk from climate change.
所有这些考虑都使过去的社会面临气候变化带来的更大风险。
paragraphs.gist: 若湿润与干旱轮换的周期长过一代人的记忆，社会容易在丰年扩大人口和用水，干旱来时又缺乏跨区调粮机制而陷入困境。

paragraphs.brief: 环境耗损和气候变动叠加
sentences: Natural climate changes may make conditions either better or worse for any particular human society, and may benefit one society while hurting another society.
自然气候变化可能改善或恶化一个社会的处境，也可能让一个社会受益，同时损害另一个。
(For example, we shall see that the Little Ice Age was bad for the Greenland Norse but good for the Greenland Inuit.)
例如，小冰期不利于格陵兰岛的诺斯人，却有利于当地因纽特人。

In many historical cases, a society that was depleting its environmental resources could absorb the losses as long as the climate was benign, but was then driven over the brink of collapse when the climate became drier, colder, hotter, wetter, or more variable.
在许多历史案例中，一个消耗环境资源的社会只要气候是良性的，就可以吸收损失，但当气候变得干燥、寒冷、炎热、湿润或变幻莫测时，却被推过崩溃的边缘。
Should one then say that the collapse was caused by human environmental impact, or by climate change?
那么，是否应该说，崩溃是由人类环境影响或气候变化造成的？
Neither of those simple alternatives is correct.
这两种简单的选择都不正确。
Instead, if the society hadn’t already partly depleted its environmental resources, it might have survived the resource depletion caused by climate change.
一个社会若没有先消耗掉一部分环境资源，就可能熬过气候变化带来的资源减少。
Conversely, it was able to survive its self-inflicted resource depletion until climate change produced further resource depletion.
反过来，自身造成的资源损耗原本也承受得住，直到气候变化进一步加剧资源枯竭。
It was neither factor taken alone, but the combination of environmental impact and climate change, that proved fatal.
真正致命的是人类环境影响与气候变化共同作用。
paragraphs.gist: 同一气候变化对不同社会的影响可相反，而资源本已因人类活动耗损的社会，更可能在气候进一步恶化时越过崩溃临界点。

paragraphs.brief: 区分征服的近因与衰弱根源
sentences: A third consideration is hostile neighbors.
第三个考虑因素是敌对的邻居。
All but a few historical societies have been geographically close enough to some other societies to have had at least some contact with them.
历史上除极少数例外，各社会都与某些其他社会在地理上足够接近，彼此至少有过一些接触。
Relations with neighboring societies may be intermittently or chronically hostile.
与邻国社会的关系可能间歇性或长期敌对。
A society may be able to hold off its enemies as long as it is strong, only to succumb when it becomes weakened for any reason, including environmental damage.
一个社会强盛时能挡住敌人，直到由于环境破坏或其他原因而衰弱，才可能败下阵来。
The proximate cause of the collapse will then be military conquest, but the ultimate cause—the factor whose change led to the collapse—will have been the factor that caused the weakening.
然后，崩溃的近因将是军事征服，但最终原因——其变化导致崩溃的因素——将是导致削弱的因素。
Hence collapses for ecological or other reasons often masquerade as military defeats.
因此，生态或其他原因造成的崩溃，表面上往往呈现为军事失败。
paragraphs.gist: 军事征服可能是社会崩溃的直接经过，但如果敌人只在对方因环境或其他问题而衰弱后才取胜，真正改变局势的原因还须往前追溯。

paragraphs.brief: 罗马早已面对反复入侵
sentences: The most familiar debate about such possible masquerading involves the fall of the Western Roman Empire.
围绕这种表面原因是否掩盖根源的争论，最著名的例子是西罗马帝国覆亡。

Rome became increasingly beset by barbarian invasions, with the conventional date for the Empire’s fall being taken somewhat arbitrarily as A.D. 476, the year in which the last emperor of the West was deposed.
罗马越来越受到野蛮入侵的困扰，传统时期的帝国解体被武断地视为A.D.476，是西方最后一位皇帝被推翻的一年。

However, even before the rise of the Roman Empire, there had been “barbarian” tribes who lived in northern Europe and Central Asia beyond the borders of “civilized” Mediterranean Europe, and who periodically attacked civilized Europe (as well as civilized China and India).
然而，甚至在罗马帝国崛起之前，就有一些“野蛮”部落生活在“文明”的地中海欧洲以外的北欧和中亚，他们定期攻击文明的欧洲(以及文明的中国和印度)。

For over a thousand years, Rome successfully held off the barbarians, for instance slaughtering a large invading force of Cimbri and Teutones bent on conquering northern Italy at the Battle of Campi Raudii in 101 B.C.
一千多年来，罗马成功地阻止了野蛮人，例如屠杀了辛布里和特奥顿斯的一支庞大侵略部队，他们执意在公元前101年的坎皮·罗迪战役中征服意大利北部。
paragraphs.gist: 西罗马灭亡常被归因于外族入侵，但这些力量此前长期存在，罗马也曾有效击退它们，因此单有入侵史解释不了后来的转折。

paragraphs.brief: 外敌变强还是自身衰弱
sentences: Eventually, it was the barbarians rather than Romans who won the battles: what was the fundamental reason for that shift in fortune?
最后，胜利者变成了所谓“蛮族”，罗马反成败方；造成这种局势逆转的根本原因究竟是什么？

Was it because of changes in the barbarians themselves, such that they became more numerous or better organized, acquired better weapons or more horses, or profited from climate change in the Central Asian steppes?
难道是因为野蛮人本身的变化，使他们变得更多或更有组织，获得更好的武器或更多的马匹，或从中亚草原的气候变化中获利？
In that case, we would say that barbarians really could be identified as the fundamental cause of Rome’s fall.
如此一来，我们要说，野蛮人确实可以被确定为罗马垮台的根本原因。

Or was it instead that the same old unchanged barbarians were always waiting on the Roman Empire’s frontiers, and that they couldn’t prevail until Rome became weakened by some combination of economic, political, environmental, and other problems?
还是说那些老的野蛮人总是在罗马帝国的边界上等待着呢？直到罗马被一些经济、政治、环境和其他问题的结合所削弱，他们才能占上风？
In that case we would blame Rome’s fall on its own problems, with the barbarians just providing the coup de grâce.
如果是后一种情况，罗马应当归咎于自己的问题，外敌不过是给予了最后一击。
This question continues to be debated.
这一问题仍在辩论之中。

Essentially the same question has been debated for the fall of the Khmer Empire centered on Angkor Wat in relation to invasions by Thai neighbors, for the decline in Harappan Indus Valley civilization in relation to Aryan invasions, and for the fall of Mycenaean Greece and other Bronze Age Mediterranean societies in relation to invasions by Sea Peoples.
类似争论还涉及吴哥的高棉帝国与泰人的入侵、印度河流域哈拉帕文明与雅利安人的入侵，以及迈锡尼希腊等地中海青铜时代社会与“海上民族”的入侵。
paragraphs.gist: 罗马究竟败于邻族实力增强还是自身长期衰弱仍有争议，同样的因果疑问也见于对高棉、印度河谷和迈锡尼等文明衰落的讨论。

paragraphs.brief: 友好贸易伙伴衰退的连锁影响
sentences: The fourth set of factors is the converse of the third set: decreased support by friendly neighbors, as opposed to increased attacks by hostile neighbors.
第四类因素与第三类相对应：除了敌对邻国加强攻击，友好邻国减少支持也可能使社会陷入困境。
All but a few historical societies have had friendly trade partners as well as neighboring enemies.
除少数历史社会外，所有社会都有友好的贸易伙伴和邻国的敌人。
Often, the partner and the enemy are one and the same neighbor, whose behavior shifts back and forth between friendly and hostile.
贸易伙伴和敌人往往就是同一个邻国，彼此关系可以在友好和敌对之间转变。

Most societies depend to some extent on friendly neighbors, either for imports of essential trade goods (like U.S. imports of oil, and Japanese imports of oil, wood, and seafood, today), or else for cultural ties that lend cohesion to the society (such as Australia’s cultural identity imported from Britain until recently).
大部分社会在某种程度上依赖友好邻国进口基本贸易商品(比如美国进口石油，日本进口石油、木材和海产食品，如今)，或者建立文化联系，使社会凝聚起来(比如澳大利亚直到最近才从英国进口的文化特性)。

Hence the risk arises that, if your trade partner becomes weakened for any reason (including environmental damage) and can no longer supply the essential import or the cultural tie, your own society may become weakened as a result.
因此，风险是，如果你的贸易伙伴因任何原因(包括环境损害)变得虚弱，不再能够提供必需的进口或文化联系，那么，你的社会就会因此变得虚弱。
This is a familiar problem today because of the First World’s dependence on oil from ecologically fragile and politically troubled Third World countries that imposed an oil embargo in 1973.
今天，这是一个人们所熟悉的问题，因为第一世界依赖1973年实施石油禁运的生态脆弱和政治动荡不安的第三世界国家的石油。
Similar problems arose in the past for the Greenland Norse, Pitcairn Islanders, and other societies.
格陵兰岛的诺斯人、皮特凯恩岛居民和其他过去的社会也曾面临类似问题。
paragraphs.gist: 盟友和贸易伙伴衰弱也会造成危机，依赖外来石油、其他必需品或文化纽带的社会，可能因伙伴中断支持而受到连锁冲击。

paragraphs.brief: 制度和价值观影响社会应对
sentences: The last set of factors in my five-point framework involves the ubiquitous question of the society’s responses to its problems, whether those problems are environmental or not.
五点框架的最后一项适用于所有社会：不论面临的是不是环境问题，社会本身如何回应？
Different societies respond differently to similar problems.
不同的社会对类似问题的反应不同。

For instance, problems of deforestation arose for many past societies, among which Highland New Guinea, Japan, Tikopia, and Tonga developed successful forest management and continued to prosper, while Easter Island, Mangareva, and Norse Greenland failed to develop successful forest management and collapsed as a result.
许多古代社会都遇到过森林砍伐问题，新几内亚高地、日本、提科皮亚和汤加成功管理了森林，继续繁荣；复活节岛、芒阿雷瓦岛和格陵兰岛的诺斯社会未能做到，最终因而崩溃。
How can we understand such differing outcomes?
我们如何理解这种不同的结果？
A society’s responses depend on its political, economic, and social institutions and on its cultural values.
社会的反应取决于其政治、经济和社会机构及其文化价值。
Those institutions and values affect whether the society solves (or even tries to solve) its problems.
这些机构和价值观影响到社会是否解决(甚至试图解决)其问题。
In this book we shall consider this five-point framework for each past society whose collapse or persistence is discussed.
书中每讨论一个古代社会为何崩溃或得以延续，都会逐项考察这五种因素。
paragraphs.gist: 面对同样的森林砍伐，有的社会建立有效管理、有的却走向崩溃，作者以此说明制度和文化价值如何决定社会是否采取行动。

paragraphs.brief: 环境因素并非崩溃的必要条件
sentences: I should add, of course, that just as climate change, hostile neighbors, and trade partners may or may not contribute to a particular society’s collapse, environmental damage as well may or may not contribute.
当然，我应该补充说，正如气候变化、敌对的邻国和贸易伙伴可能或可能不会促成某个社会崩溃，环境损害也可能不会造成。

It would be absurd to claim that environmental damage must be a major factor in all collapses: the collapse of the Soviet Union is a modern counter-example, and the destruction of Carthage by Rome in 146 B.C. is an ancient one.
声称环境损害必须是所有崩溃的一个主要因素是荒谬的：苏联的崩溃是现代的反例子，罗马在公元前146年摧毁迦太基是古老的。
It’s obviously true that military or economic factors alone may suffice.
显然，军事或经济因素本身可能就足够了。

Hence a full title for this book would be “Societal collapses involving an environmental component, and in some cases also contributions of climate change, hostile neighbors, and trade partners, plus questions of societal responses.”
因此，这本书的完整标题将是“社会崩溃涉及环境因素，在某些情况下还包括气候变化、敌对邻国和贸易伙伴的贡献，以及社会应对问题”。
That restriction still leaves us ample modern and ancient material to consider.
这种限制仍然使我们需要考虑大量现代和古老的材料。
paragraphs.gist: 环境破坏并非每次崩溃的必要因素，苏联解体和罗马摧毁迦太基等例子表明，经济或军事因素本身便可能足以解释结局。

paragraphs.brief: 当代增长与环境争论的两端
sentences: Issues of human environmental impacts today tend to be controversial, and opinions about them tend to fall on a spectrum between two opposite camps.
今天，人类活动怎样影响环境常引发争议，各种观点大致分布在两个对立阵营之间。

One camp, usually referred to as “environmentalist” or “pro-environment,” holds that our current environmental problems are serious and in urgent need of addressing, and that current rates of economic and population growth cannot be sustained.
其中一方通常被称为“环保主义者”或“亲环保派”，认为当前环境问题严重而紧迫，经济与人口无法维持现有增长速度。
The other camp holds that environmentalists’ concerns are exaggerated and unwarranted, and that continued economic and population growth is both possible and desirable.
另一个阵营认为，环境主义者的担忧是夸大其词和毫无道理的，经济与人口的持续增长既是可能的，也是可取的。
The latter camp isn’t associated with an accepted short label, and so I shall refer to it simply as “non-environmentalist.”
另一阵营并没有公认的简称，我姑且称之为“非环保主义者”。

Its adherents come especially from the world of big business and economics, but the equation “non-environmentalist” as opposed to “pro-business” is imperfect; many business people consider themselves environmentalists, and many people skeptical of the claims of environmentalists are not in the world of big business.
其追随者尤其来自大商业和经济界，但“非环境主义者”与“有利商业”的等式并不完美；许多商界人士认为自己是环保主义者，许多人对环保主义者的主张持怀疑态度，但大商业界却并非如此。
paragraphs.gist: 作者把当代争论放在一条光谱上，一端担心环境问题迫切且增长难以持续，另一端则认为忧虑被夸大、经济与人口增长仍可继续。
